fixture: canonical base16 text chunks for binary-semantic payload

sources.name: RFC 4648
sources.use: Base16 uses two printable hexadecimal characters per octet and requires no padding.

sources.name: GitHub repository contents API
sources.use: Repository content updates are content/CAS-style text transport in this Chat connector; concurrent content mutations can conflict and must be serialized/reconciled.

semantic_byte_preservation.meaning: The UTF-8 repository state contains a canonical, deterministic textual specification from which exactly one 16-octet sequence is defined; no binary-write tool is required to preserve or audit that semantic content.

raw_binary_artifact_materialization.meaning: The current Chat GitHub mutation surface accepts UTF-8 text. This fixture intentionally creates no raw binary file. If the useful outcome requires a consumer-visible binary file rather than a canonical byte specification, a decoder/materializer or binary-write capability is still required; that residual execution step is disallowed by Phase-1 acceptance.

quota_and_cost.note: Low-volume repository API transport remains a rate-limited transport assumption; the mechanism does not use API calls as compute.

scope: Tiny bounded payload, canonical uppercase RFC4648 base16 identity-addressed chunks and manifest only. Does not claim efficient storage for large blobs, raw binary-file materialization, executable decoding, media rendering, environment-sensitive build/test behavior or arbitrary artifact parity.
